movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>≠</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></munder><mrow><mi>ℙ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>⟨</mo><mrow><mi>𝒁</mi><mo>,</mo><mfrac><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>d</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>j</mi></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>d</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>j</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo>⟩</mo></mrow><mo>&gt;</mo><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>d</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>j</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>σ</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>σ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>κ</mi><mi>ϵ</mi></msub></mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>d</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>j</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="0.111em">=</mo><mrow><munder><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>≠</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></munder><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>F</mi><mo>~</mo></mover><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>d</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>j</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>σ</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>σ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>κ</mi><mi>ϵ</mi></msub></mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>d</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>j</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mphantom></mphantom><mo lspace="0.278em" rspace="0.278em">:</mo><mi>δ</mi></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{P}(\mathcal{E}^{c})\leq\sum_{j\neq 1}\mathbb{P}\left(\left\langle\bm{Z},\frac{\hat{d}_{j}}{\|\hat{d}_{j}\|}\right\rangle&gt;\frac{\|\hat{d}_{j}\|}{2\sigma}+\frac{\sigma\kappa_{\epsilon}}{\|\hat{d}_{j}\|}\right)=\sum_{j\neq 1}\tilde{F}\left(\frac{\|\hat{d}_{j}\|}{2\sigma}+\frac{\sigma\kappa_{\epsilon}}{\|\hat{d}_{j}\|}\right)=:\delta.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A1.SS2.p2.9" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS2.p2.9.1" class="ltx_text">Recall</span></p>

</table>
<p id="A1.SS2.p2.10" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS2.p2.10.1" class="ltx_text">so</span></p>

<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A1.Ex44.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\|m_{\sigma}(\bm{X}_{\sigma})-x_{1}\|=\Big\|\sum_{j=1}^{N}w_{j}(x_{j}-x_{1})\Big\|\leq\sum_{j\neq 1}w_{j}\|x_{j}-x_{1}\|\leq D(1-w_{1})." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em" stretchy="true">‖</mo><mrow><munderover><mo lspace="0em" movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>N</mi></munderover><mrow><msub><mi>w</mi><mi>j</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>j</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em" stretchy="true">‖</mo></mrow><mo rspace="0.111em">≤</mo><mrow><munder><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>≠</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></munder><mrow><msub><mi>w</mi><mi>j</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>j</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mi>D</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>w</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\|m_{\sigma}(\bm{X}_{\sigma})-x_{1}\|=\Big\|\sum_{j=1}^{N}w_{j}(x_{j}-x_{1})\Big\|\leq\sum_{j\neq 1}w_{j}\|x_{j}-x_{1}\|\leq D(1-w_{1}).</annotation></semantics></math></td>

<div id="A1.SS2.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.SS2.p3.1" class="ltx_p">For the following setting let <math id="A1.SS2.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{X}_{t}:=(1-t)\bm{Z}+t\bm{X}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>:=</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>t</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝒁</mi></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝑿</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{X}_{t}:=(1-t)\bm{Z}+t\bm{X}</annotation></semantics></math> where <math id="A1.SS2.p3.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{Z}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I_{d})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝒁</mi><mo>∼</mo><mrow><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒩</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>I</mi><mi>d</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{Z}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I_{d})</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A1.SS2.p3.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{X}\sim p_{\mathcal{D}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝑿</mi><mo>∼</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒟</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{X}\sim p_{\mathcal{D}}</annotation></semantics></math>. Let <math id="A1.SS2.p3.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>u</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">u_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A1.SS2.p3.m5" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="u_{t}(\cdot\mid x_{1})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>u</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">⋅</mo><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">u_{t}(\cdot\mid x_{1})</annotation></semantics></math> be the optimal and conditional vector fields respectively in the flow matching setting <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib1" title="" class="ltx_ref">16</a>]</cite> with scheduling functions <math id="A1.SS2.p3.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha_{t}=t" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha_{t}=t</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A1.SS2.p3.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta_{t}=1-t" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>β</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>t</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\beta_{t}=1-t</annotation></semantics></math>. Then conditional vector field is given by</p>

<p id="A1.SS2.p3.3" class="ltx_p">where the weights <math id="A1.SS2.p3.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="w_{i}(x,t)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>w</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">w_{i}(x,t)</annotation></semantics></math> are given by softmax weights</p>

</table>
<p id="A1.SS2.p3.4" class="ltx_p">Following notation from <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib8" title="" class="ltx_ref">24</a>]</cite>, the empirical optimal denoiser in <math id="A1.SS2.p3.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>t</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t</annotation></semantics></math>, is then given by</p>
<table id="A1.E22" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A1.E22.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="m_{t}\left(x\right):=\mathbb{E}\left[\bm{X}\mid\bm{X}_{t}=x\right]=\sum_{i=1}^{N}w_{i}(x,t)x_{i}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>:=</mo><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mrow><mi>𝑿</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mrow><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="0.111em">=</mo><mrow><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>N</mi></munderover><mrow><msub><mi>w</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>i</mi></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">m_{t}\left(x\right):=\mathbb{E}\left[\bm{X}\mid\bm{X}_{t}=x\right]=\sum_{i=1}^{N}w_{i}(x,t)x_{i}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>

</table>
<p id="A1.SS2.p3.5" class="ltx_p">Then with <math id="A1.SS2.p3.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sigma:=(1-t)/t" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>σ</mi><mo>:=</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>t</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>/</mo><mi>t</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sigma:=(1-t)/t</annotation></semantics></math>, by direct calculation, the two empirical optimal denoisers have the following relationship:
for any <math id="A1.SS2.p3.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x\in\mathbb{R}^{d}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>∈</mo><msup><mi>ℝ</mi><mi>d</mi></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x\in\mathbb{R}^{d}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A1.SS2.p3.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t\in(0,1)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t\in(0,1)</annotation></semantics></math>, one has the following straightforward observation (which was also implicitly shown in the proof of <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib8" title="" class="ltx_ref">24</a>, Proposition 2.2]</cite>):</p>
<table id="A1.E23" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A1.E23.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="m_{t}(tx)=m_{\sigma}(x)" display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">m_{t}(tx)=m_{\sigma}(x)</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(23)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A1.SS2.p3.6" class="ltx_p">and consequently, for all <math id="A1.SS2.p3.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t\in(0,1)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t\in(0,1)</annotation></semantics></math>,</p>
<table id="A1.E24" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A1.E24.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="m_{t}\left(\bm{X}_{t}\right)=m_{\sigma}(\bm{X}_{\sigma})." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">m_{t}\left(\bm{X}_{t}\right)=m_{\sigma}(\bm{X}_{\sigma}).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(24)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A1.SS2.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.SS2.p4.1" class="ltx_p">The following corollary is designed to help explain the empirical result found in figure 1 of <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib2" title="" class="ltx_ref">2</a>]</cite>, where in high dimensions sharp concentration of the cosine similarity between the conditional and empirical optimal vector fields was observed with respect to the flow matching setting with linear scheduling.</p>
</div>
<div id="A1.Thmtheorem2" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_corollary">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A1.Thmtheorem2.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Corollary A.2</span></span><span id="A1.Thmtheorem2.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">.</span></h6>
<div id="A1.Thmtheorem2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.Thmtheorem2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.Thmtheorem2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Assume the setting in <a href="#A1.Thmtheorem1" title="Lemma A.1. ‣ A.2 Cosine Similarity Concentration ‣ Appendix A Posterior Concentration and Cosine Similarity Concentration ‣ Two Calm Ends and the Wild Middle:A Geometric Picture of Memorization in Diffusion Models" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Lemma</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">A.1</span></a> for <math id="A1.Thmtheorem2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{D}=\{x_{1},\dots,x_{N}\}\subset\mathbb{R}^{d}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒟</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>N</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow><mo>⊂</mo><msup><mi>ℝ</mi><mi>d</mi></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{D}=\{x_{1},\dots,x_{N}\}\subset\mathbb{R}^{d}</annotation></semantics></math>. Condition on <math id="A1.Thmtheorem2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{X}=x_{1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝐗</mi><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{X}=x_{1}</annotation></semantics></math> and suppose <math id="A1.Thmtheorem2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x_{1}\neq 0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>≠</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x_{1}\neq 0</annotation></semantics></math>. Pick constants <math id="A1.Thmtheorem2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="a,c&gt;0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">a,c&gt;0</annotation></semantics></math> and fix <math id="A1.Thmtheorem2.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\epsilon&gt;0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>ϵ</mi><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\epsilon&gt;0</annotation></semantics></math>. Then with probability at least <math id="A1.Thmtheorem2.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1-\delta_{\epsilon,a,c}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>δ</mi><mrow><mi>ϵ</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1-\delta_{\epsilon,a,c}</annotation></semantics></math></span></p>

<p id="A1.Thmtheorem2.p1.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.Thmtheorem2.p1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">and <math id="A1.Thmtheorem2.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tilde{F}:=1-F" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>F</mi><mo>~</mo></mover><mo>:=</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>F</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tilde{F}:=1-F</annotation></semantics></math> where <math id="A1.Thmtheorem2.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="F" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>F</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">F</annotation></semantics></math> is the CDF of the standard normal distribution.</span></p>

<div id="A1.Thmtheorem3" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_remark">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A1.Thmtheorem3.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Remark A.3</span></span><span id="A1.Thmtheorem3.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">.</span></h6>
<div id="A1.Thmtheorem3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.Thmtheorem3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The strong dependence on the dimension <math id="A1.Thmtheorem3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="d" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>d</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">d</annotation></semantics></math> should be noted in the bound. For empirical validation we use the CIFAR-10 dataset consisting of 50K images embedded into <math id="A1.Thmtheorem3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[-1,1]^{3072}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mn>3072</mn></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">[-1,1]^{3072}</annotation></semantics></math> in the standard manner. At <math id="A1.Thmtheorem3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t=0.4" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0.4</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t=0.4</annotation></semantics></math> ( equivalently <math id="A1.Thmtheorem3.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sigma=1.5" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>σ</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1.5</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sigma=1.5</annotation></semantics></math>) with <math id="A1.Thmtheorem3.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\epsilon=0.01" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>ϵ</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0.01</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\epsilon=0.01</annotation></semantics></math>, <math id="A1.Thmtheorem3.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="a=8" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">a=8</annotation></semantics></math> , and <math id="A1.Thmtheorem3.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="c=5" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">c=5</annotation></semantics></math>, averaging over a random sample of 500 images, <a href="#A1.Thmtheorem2" title="Corollary A.2. ‣ A.2 Cosine Similarity Concentration ‣ Appendix A Posterior Concentration and Cosine Similarity Concentration ‣ Two Calm Ends and the Wild Middle:A Geometric Picture of Memorization in Diffusion Models" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Corollary</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">A.2</span></a> yields an average lower bound for the cosine similarity of <math id="A1.Thmtheorem3.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.940" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.940</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.940</annotation></semantics></math> with an average probability of <math id="A1.Thmtheorem3.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.941" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.941</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.941</annotation></semantics></math>. Though stronger concentration is seen in figure 1 of <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib2" title="" class="ltx_ref">2</a>]</cite> for smaller values of <math id="A1.Thmtheorem3.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>t</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t</annotation></semantics></math>, this result conveys the effect of high dimension and dataset diameter on alignment between <math id="A1.Thmtheorem3.p1.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u_{t}(\bm{X}_{t})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>u</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">u_{t}(\bm{X}_{t})</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A1.Thmtheorem3.p1.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="u_{t}(\bm{X}_{t}\mid x_{1})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>u</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo fence="true" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∣</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">u_{t}(\bm{X}_{t}\mid x_{1})</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div id="A1.SS2.3" class="ltx_proof">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_font_italic ltx_title_proof">Proof.</h6>
<div id="A1.SS2.p5" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.SS2.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS2.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text">Let <math id="A1.SS2.p5.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\epsilon,a,c&gt;0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>ϵ</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\epsilon,a,c&gt;0</annotation></semantics></math>. From <math id="A1.SS2.p5.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{X}=x_{1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝑿</mi><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{X}=x_{1}</annotation></semantics></math> we have <math id="A1.SS2.p5.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{X}_{t}=(1-t)\bm{Z}+tx_{1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>t</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝒁</mi></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{X}_{t}=(1-t)\bm{Z}+tx_{1}</annotation></semantics></math>. Plugging <math id="A1.SS2.p5.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{X}_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{X}_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> into <a href="#A1.E20" title="In A.2 Cosine Similarity Concentration ‣ Appendix A Posterior Concentration and Cosine Similarity Concentration ‣ Two Calm Ends and the Wild Middle:A Geometric Picture of Memorization in Diffusion Models" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Eqn.</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">20</span></a> and <a href="#A1.E21" title="In A.2 Cosine Similarity Concentration ‣ Appendix A Posterior Concentration and Cosine Similarity Concentration ‣ Two Calm Ends and the Wild Middle:A Geometric Picture of Memorization in Diffusion Models" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Eqn.</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">21</span></a> and then simplifying yields</span></p>

<p id="A1.SS2.p5.7" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS2.p5.7.1" class="ltx_text">Note since <math id="A1.SS2.p5.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\langle\bm{Z},x_{1}\rangle\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\|x_{1}\|^{2})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><mrow><mi>𝒁</mi><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow><mo>∼</mo><mrow><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒩</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\langle\bm{Z},x_{1}\rangle\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\|x_{1}\|^{2})</annotation></semantics></math> we have</span></p>

Furthermore by the Laurent-Massart inequality <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib15" title="" class="ltx_ref">14</a>]</cite>, we have with regrettable notation</span></p>

</div>

</section>
</section>
<section id="A2" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix B </span>Gaussian Shell and Coverage</h2>

<div id="A2.2" class="ltx_proof">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_font_italic ltx_title_proof">Proof of <a href="#S4.Thmtheorem5" title="Lemma 4.5 (Gaussian concentration []). ‣ 4.1 Key Players for Per-Noise-Level Memorizations ‣ 4 Geometric Interpretation of Noise Regimes ‣ Two Calm Ends and the Wild Middle:A Geometric Picture of Memorization in Diffusion Models" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Lemma</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">4.5</span></a>.</h6>
<div id="A2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text">We first recall a standard concentration inequality for chi-square random variables due to Laurent and Massart <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib15" title="" class="ltx_ref">14</a>]</cite>.</span></p>
</div>
<div id="A2.Thmtheorem1" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_lemma">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A2.Thmtheorem1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Lemma B.1</span></span><span id="A2.Thmtheorem1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">.</span></h6>
<div id="A2.Thmtheorem1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.Thmtheorem1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.Thmtheorem1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Let <math id="A2.Thmtheorem1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{R}\sim\chi^{2}_{d}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝐑</mi><mo>∼</mo><msubsup><mi>χ</mi><mi>d</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{R}\sim\chi^{2}_{d}</annotation></semantics></math>.
Then for every <math id="A2.Thmtheorem1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="c&gt;0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">c&gt;0</annotation></semantics></math>,</span></p>
<table id="A2.EGx4" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A2.E29"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.E29.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\mathbb{P}\!\left(\bm{R}-d\geq 2\sqrt{dc}+2c\right)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mpadded style="width:0.441em;" width="0.441em"><mi>ℙ</mi></mpadded><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>𝑹</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mo>≥</mo><mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\mathbb{P}\!\left(\bm{R}-d\geq 2\sqrt{dc}+2c\right)</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.E29.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\leq e^{-c}," display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>≤</mo><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></msup></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\leq e^{-c},</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(29)</span></td></tr></tbody>
<tbody id="A2.E30"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.E30.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\mathbb{P}\!\left(d-\bm{R}\geq 2\sqrt{dc}\right)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mpadded style="width:0.441em;" width="0.441em"><mi>ℙ</mi></mpadded><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>𝑹</mi></mrow><mo>≥</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\mathbb{P}\!\left(d-\bm{R}\geq 2\sqrt{dc}\right)</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.E30.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\leq e^{-c}." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>≤</mo><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></msup></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\leq e^{-c}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(30)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div id="A2.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text">Now we let <math id="A2.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{S}:=\|\bm{Z}\|^{2}\sim\chi^{2}_{d}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝑺</mi><mo>:=</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝒁</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>∼</mo><msubsup><mi>χ</mi><mi>d</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{S}:=\|\bm{Z}\|^{2}\sim\chi^{2}_{d}</annotation></semantics></math>. By <a href="#A2.Thmtheorem1" title="Lemma B.1. ‣ Proof of . ‣ Appendix B Gaussian Shell and Coverage ‣ Two Calm Ends and the Wild Middle:A Geometric Picture of Memorization in Diffusion Models" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Lemma</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">B.1</span></a> above, for every <math id="A2.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="c\geq 0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>≥</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">c\geq 0</annotation></semantics></math>,</span></p>
<table id="A2.Ex63" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex63.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{P}\big(\bm{S}\geq d+2\sqrt{cd}+2c\big)\leq e^{-c},\qquad\mathbb{P}\big(\bm{S}\leq d-2\sqrt{cd}\big)\leq e^{-c}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>ℙ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">(</mo><mrow><mi>𝑺</mi><mo>≥</mo><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>+</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≤</mo><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></msup></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>ℙ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">(</mo><mrow><mi>𝑺</mi><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>−</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≤</mo><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></msup></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{P}\big(\bm{S}\geq d+2\sqrt{cd}+2c\big)\leq e^{-c},\qquad\mathbb{P}\big(\bm{S}\leq d-2\sqrt{cd}\big)\leq e^{-c}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.p2.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.p2.2.1" class="ltx_text">Therefore,</span></p>
<table id="A2.Ex64" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex64.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{P}\Big(d-2\sqrt{cd}\leq\bm{S}\leq d+2\sqrt{cd}+2c\Big)\geq 1-2e^{-c}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>ℙ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em">(</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>−</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mi>𝑺</mi><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>+</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≥</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></msup></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{P}\Big(d-2\sqrt{cd}\leq\bm{S}\leq d+2\sqrt{cd}+2c\Big)\geq 1-2e^{-c}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.p2.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.p2.3.1" class="ltx_text">Since <math id="A2.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\big(r^{\mathrm{in}}_{c,d}\big)^{2}=d-2\sqrt{cd}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">(</mo><msubsup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mi>in</mi></msubsup><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>−</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\big(r^{\mathrm{in}}_{c,d}\big)^{2}=d-2\sqrt{cd}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A2.p2.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\big(r^{\mathrm{out}}_{c,d}\big)^{2}=d+2\sqrt{cd}+2c" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">(</mo><msubsup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mi>out</mi></msubsup><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>+</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\big(r^{\mathrm{out}}_{c,d}\big)^{2}=d+2\sqrt{cd}+2c</annotation></semantics></math>, taking square roots yields</span></p>
<table id="A2.Ex65" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex65.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{P}\big(\|\bm{Z}\|\in[r^{\mathrm{in}}_{c,d},r^{\mathrm{out}}_{c,d}]\big)\geq 1-2e^{-c}," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>ℙ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">(</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝒁</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msubsup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mi>in</mi></msubsup><mo>,</mo><msubsup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mi>out</mi></msubsup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≥</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></msup></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{P}\big(\|\bm{Z}\|\in[r^{\mathrm{in}}_{c,d},r^{\mathrm{out}}_{c,d}]\big)\geq 1-2e^{-c},</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.p2.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.p2.4.1" class="ltx_text">which proves the lemma.
∎</span></p>

<section id="A2.SS1" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">B.1 </span>Proof of <a href="#S4.Thmtheorem8" title="Theorem 4.8. ‣ 4.1 Key Players for Per-Noise-Level Memorizations ‣ 4 Geometric Interpretation of Noise Regimes ‣ Two Calm Ends and the Wild Middle:A Geometric Picture of Memorization in Diffusion Models" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Theorem</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">4.8</span></a></h3>

<div id="A2.SS1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We first introduce some terminology to assist with the proof.
Let <math id="A2.SS1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\Omega,\mathcal{F},\mathbb{P})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi><mo>,</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℱ</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>ℙ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(\Omega,\mathcal{F},\mathbb{P})</annotation></semantics></math> be a probability space supporting random variables</p>
<table id="A2.Ex66" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex66.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{X},\bm{X}^{\prime},\bm{X}_{1},\dots,\bm{X}_{N}:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}^{d},\qquad\bm{Z}:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}^{d}," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>𝑿</mi><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>𝑿</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>N</mi></msub><mo lspace="0.278em" rspace="0.278em">:</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><msup><mi>ℝ</mi><mi>d</mi></msup></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><mi>𝒁</mi><mo lspace="0.278em" rspace="0.278em">:</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><msup><mi>ℝ</mi><mi>d</mi></msup></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{X},\bm{X}^{\prime},\bm{X}_{1},\dots,\bm{X}_{N}:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}^{d},\qquad\bm{Z}:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}^{d},</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.p1.2" class="ltx_p">such that <math id="A2.SS1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{X},\bm{X}^{\prime},\bm{X}_{1},\dots,\bm{X}_{N}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝑿</mi><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>𝑿</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>N</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{X},\bm{X}^{\prime},\bm{X}_{1},\dots,\bm{X}_{N}</annotation></semantics></math> are i.i.d. with law <math id="A2.SS1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="p" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>p</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">p</annotation></semantics></math>, and <math id="A2.SS1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{Z}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I_{d})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝒁</mi><mo>∼</mo><mrow><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒩</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>I</mi><mi>d</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{Z}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I_{d})</annotation></semantics></math> is independent.</p>
</div>
<div id="A2.SS1.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS1.p2.1" class="ltx_p">We first recall the following result:</p>
</div>
<div id="A2.Thmtheorem2" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_lemma">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A2.Thmtheorem2.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Lemma B.2</span></span><span id="A2.Thmtheorem2.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold"> </span>(Example 4.1.7 in <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib24" title="" class="ltx_ref">5</a>]</cite>)<span id="A2.Thmtheorem2.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">.</span></h6>
<div id="A2.Thmtheorem2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.Thmtheorem2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.Thmtheorem2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Let <math id="A2.Thmtheorem2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{A}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>𝐀</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{A}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A2.Thmtheorem2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{B}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>𝐁</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{B}</annotation></semantics></math> be independent random variables and let
<math id="A2.Thmtheorem2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\varphi" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>φ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\varphi</annotation></semantics></math> be an integrable function such that
<math id="A2.Thmtheorem2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{E}[|\varphi(\bm{A},\bm{B})|]&lt;\infty" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mrow><mi>φ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>𝐀</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>𝐁</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>&lt;</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">∞</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{E}[|\varphi(\bm{A},\bm{B})|]&lt;\infty</annotation></semantics></math>.
Define</span></p>
<table id="A2.Ex67" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex67.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="g(a):=\mathbb{E}[\varphi(a,\bm{B})]." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>g</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>:=</mo><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mi>φ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>𝑩</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">g(a):=\mathbb{E}[\varphi(a,\bm{B})].</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.Thmtheorem2.p1.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.Thmtheorem2.p1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Then</span></p>
<table id="A2.Ex68" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">

</table>
</div>
</div>
<div id="A2.Thmtheorem3" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_lemma">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A2.Thmtheorem3.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Lemma B.3</span></span><span id="A2.Thmtheorem3.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">.</span></h6>
<div id="A2.Thmtheorem3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.Thmtheorem3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.Thmtheorem3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">For each <math id="A2.Thmtheorem3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="i=1,\dots,N" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>N</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">i=1,\dots,N</annotation></semantics></math>, define</span></p>
<table id="A2.Ex69" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex69.m1" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="I_{i}:=\mathbf{1}_{\{\bm{X}_{\sigma}\in S_{\sigma}({\bm{X}_{i}})\}}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>I</mi><msub><mrow></mrow><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>:=</mo><mn>𝟏</mn><msub><mrow></mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mi>𝑿</mi><msub><mrow></mrow><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo>∈</mo><mi>S</mi><msub><mrow></mrow><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>𝑿</mi><msub><mrow></mrow><mi>i</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">I_{i}:=\mathbf{1}_{\{\bm{X}_{\sigma}\in S_{\sigma}({\bm{X}_{i}})\}}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.Thmtheorem3.p1.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.Thmtheorem3.p1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Then:</span></p>
<ol id="A2.I1" class="ltx_enumerate">
<li id="A2.I1.ix1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">(i)</span> 
<div id="A2.I1.ix1.p1" class="ltx_para">

<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.I1.ix1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.I1.ix1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">where</span></p>
<table id="A2.Ex71" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">

<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex71.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="q_{\sigma}(y)=\mathbb{P}\bigl(y\in S_{\sigma}({\bm{X}^{\prime}})\bigr)," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>q</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>ℙ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">(</mo><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><msub><mi>S</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>𝑿</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">q_{\sigma}(y)=\mathbb{P}\bigl(y\in S_{\sigma}({\bm{X}^{\prime}})\bigr),</annotation></semantics></math></td>

</table>
<p id="A2.I1.ix1.p1.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.I1.ix1.p1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">and </span><math id="A2.I1.ix1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{X}^{\prime}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>𝑿</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{X}^{\prime}</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A2.I1.ix1.p1.2.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> is an independent copy of </span><math id="A2.I1.ix1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{X}_{1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{X}_{1}</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A2.I1.ix1.p1.2.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">.</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A2.I1.ix2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">(ii)</span> 
<div id="A2.I1.ix2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.I1.ix2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.I1.ix2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">The family </span><math id="A2.I1.ix2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(I_{1},\dots,I_{N})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>I</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>I</mi><mi>N</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(I_{1},\dots,I_{N})</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A2.I1.ix2.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> is conditionally independent given
</span><math id="A2.I1.ix2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{X}_{\sigma}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{X}_{\sigma}</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A2.I1.ix2.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">.</span></p>
</div></li>
</ol>
<p id="A2.Thmtheorem3.p1.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.Thmtheorem3.p1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Consequently, conditional on <math id="A2.Thmtheorem3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{X}_{\sigma}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>𝐗</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{X}_{\sigma}</annotation></semantics></math>, the random variables
<math id="A2.Thmtheorem3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="I_{1},\dots,I_{N}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>I</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>I</mi><mi>N</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">I_{1},\dots,I_{N}</annotation></semantics></math> are i.i.d. Bernoulli with parameter
<math id="A2.Thmtheorem3.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="q_{\sigma}(\bm{X}_{\sigma})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>q</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝐗</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">q_{\sigma}(\bm{X}_{\sigma})</annotation></semantics></math>.</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<div id="A2.SS1.2" class="ltx_proof">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_font_italic ltx_title_proof">Proof.</h6>
<div id="A2.SS1.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS1.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text">Since <math id="A2.SS1.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\bm{X}_{1},\dots,\bm{X}_{N})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>N</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(\bm{X}_{1},\dots,\bm{X}_{N})</annotation></semantics></math> is independent of <math id="A2.SS1.p3.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\bm{X},\bm{Z})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>𝑿</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>𝒁</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(\bm{X},\bm{Z})</annotation></semantics></math> and
<math id="A2.SS1.p3.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{X}_{\sigma}=\bm{X}+\sigma\bm{Z}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>𝑿</mi><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi>σ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝒁</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{X}_{\sigma}=\bm{X}+\sigma\bm{Z}</annotation></semantics></math> is measurable with respect to
<math id="A2.SS1.p3.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\bm{X},\bm{Z})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>𝑿</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>𝒁</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(\bm{X},\bm{Z})</annotation></semantics></math>, it follows that <math id="A2.SS1.p3.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\bm{X}_{1},\dots,\bm{X}_{N})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>N</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(\bm{X}_{1},\dots,\bm{X}_{N})</annotation></semantics></math> is independent
of <math id="A2.SS1.p3.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{X}_{\sigma}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{X}_{\sigma}</annotation></semantics></math>.</span></p>
</div>
<div id="A2.SS1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.SS1.p4.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">(i)</span>
Define <math id="A2.SS1.p4.m1" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="\varphi(y,x):=\mathbf{1}_{\{y\in S_{\sigma}({x})\}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>φ</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>:=</mo><msub><mn>𝟏</mn><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>S</mi><msub><mrow></mrow><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\varphi(y,x):=\mathbf{1}_{\{y\in S_{\sigma}({x})\}}</annotation></semantics></math>,
<math id="A2.SS1.p4.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="I_{i}=\varphi(\bm{X}_{\sigma},\bm{X}_{i})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>I</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>φ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">I_{i}=\varphi(\bm{X}_{\sigma},\bm{X}_{i})</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
<div id="A2.SS1.p5" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS1.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text">Since <math id="A2.SS1.p5.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{X}_{\sigma}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{X}_{\sigma}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A2.SS1.p5.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{X}_{i}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{X}_{i}</annotation></semantics></math> are independent and <math id="A2.SS1.p5.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\varphi" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>φ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\varphi</annotation></semantics></math> is bounded,
Lemma <a href="#A2.Thmtheorem2" title="Lemma B.2 (Example 4.1.7 in []). ‣ B.1 Proof of ‣ Appendix B Gaussian Shell and Coverage ‣ Two Calm Ends and the Wild Middle:A Geometric Picture of Memorization in Diffusion Models" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">B.2</span></a> yields</span></p>
<table id="A2.Ex72" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex72.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{E}[I_{i}\mid\bm{X}_{\sigma}]=\mathbb{E}[\varphi(\bm{X}_{\sigma},\bm{X}_{i})\mid\bm{X}_{\sigma}]=g(\bm{X}_{\sigma})," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msub><mi>I</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>φ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>g</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{E}[I_{i}\mid\bm{X}_{\sigma}]=\mathbb{E}[\varphi(\bm{X}_{\sigma},\bm{X}_{i})\mid\bm{X}_{\sigma}]=g(\bm{X}_{\sigma}),</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.p5.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p5.2.1" class="ltx_text">where
<math id="A2.SS1.p5.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="g(y)=\mathbb{E}[\varphi(y,\bm{X}_{i})]=\mathbb{P}\bigl(y\in S_{\sigma}({\bm{X}_{i}})\bigr)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>g</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mi>φ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>ℙ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">(</mo><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><msub><mi>S</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">g(y)=\mathbb{E}[\varphi(y,\bm{X}_{i})]=\mathbb{P}\bigl(y\in S_{\sigma}({\bm{X}_{i}})\bigr)</annotation></semantics></math>.</span></p>
</div>
<div id="A2.SS1.p6" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS1.p6.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p6.1.1" class="ltx_text">Since <math id="A2.SS1.p6.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{X}_{i}\stackrel{{\scriptstyle d}}{{=}}\bm{X}^{\prime}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mover><mo>=</mo><mi>d</mi></mover><msup><mi>𝑿</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{X}_{i}\stackrel{{\scriptstyle d}}{{=}}\bm{X}^{\prime}</annotation></semantics></math>, we have <math id="A2.SS1.p6.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="g(y)=q_{\sigma}(y)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>g</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>q</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">g(y)=q_{\sigma}(y)</annotation></semantics></math> for all <math id="A2.SS1.p6.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="y" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>y</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y</annotation></semantics></math>.
Hence</span></p>
<table id="A2.Ex73" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>

<p id="A2.SS1.p7.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">(ii)</span>
Let <math id="A2.SS1.p7.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="J\subset\{1,\dots,N\}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>J</mi><mo>⊂</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>N</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">J\subset\{1,\dots,N\}</annotation></semantics></math> be finite and nonempty, and fix
<math id="A2.SS1.p7.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\varepsilon_{j}\in\{0,1\}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>ε</mi><mi>j</mi></msub><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\varepsilon_{j}\in\{0,1\}</annotation></semantics></math> for each <math id="A2.SS1.p7.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="j\in J" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>J</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">j\in J</annotation></semantics></math>.

<p id="A2.SS1.p8.5" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p8.5.1" class="ltx_text">which proves that <math id="A2.SS1.p8.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(I_{1},\dots,I_{N})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>I</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>I</mi><mi>N</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(I_{1},\dots,I_{N})</annotation></semantics></math> is conditionally independent given <math id="A2.SS1.p8.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{X}_{\sigma}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{X}_{\sigma}</annotation></semantics></math>.</span></p>

<p id="A2.SS1.p9.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p9.1.1" class="ltx_text">Finally, by part (i),</span></p>

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex81.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{P}(I_{i}=1\mid\bm{X}_{\sigma})=\mathbb{E}[I_{i}\mid\bm{X}_{\sigma}]=q_{\sigma}(\bm{X}_{\sigma})," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>ℙ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>I</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo fence="true" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∣</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msub><mi>I</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.167em">∣</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>q</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{P}(I_{i}=1\mid\bm{X}_{\sigma})=\mathbb{E}[I_{i}\mid\bm{X}_{\sigma}]=q_{\sigma}(\bm{X}_{\sigma}),</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.p9.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p9.2.1" class="ltx_text">so <math id="A2.SS1.p9.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(I_{1},\dots,I_{N})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>I</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>I</mi><mi>N</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(I_{1},\dots,I_{N})</annotation></semantics></math> are conditionally i.i.d. Bernoulli with parameter
<math id="A2.SS1.p9.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="q_{\sigma}(\bm{X}_{\sigma})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>q</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>𝑿</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">q_{\sigma}(\bm{X}_{\sigma})</annotation></semantics></math>.
∎</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<div id="A2.Thmtheorem4" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_lemma">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A2.Thmtheorem4.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Lemma B.4</span></span><span id="A2.Thmtheorem4.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">.</span></h6>
<div id="A2.Thmtheorem4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.Thmtheorem4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.Thmtheorem4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Fix <math id="A2.Thmtheorem4.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sigma&gt;0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>σ</mi><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sigma&gt;0</annotation></semantics></math>. For any deterministic <math id="A2.Thmtheorem4.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x,x^{\prime}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo>∈</mo><msup><mi>ℝ</mi><mi>d</mi></msup></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x,x^{\prime}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}</annotation></semantics></math>, define <math id="A2.Thmtheorem4.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{Y}_{x}=x+\sigma\bm{Z}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>𝐘</mi><mi>x</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi>σ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝐙</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{Y}_{x}=x+\sigma\bm{Z}</annotation></semantics></math> with <math id="A2.Thmtheorem4.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{Z}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I_{d})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝐙</mi><mo>∼</mo><mrow><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒩</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>I</mi><mi>d</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{Z}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I_{d})</annotation></semantics></math>.
Then</span></p>
<table id="A2.Ex82" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex82.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{P}\big(\bm{Y}_{x}\in S_{\sigma}({x})\cap S_{\sigma}({x^{\prime}})\big)=\Phi_{d,c}\!\left(\frac{\|x-x^{\prime}\|}{\sigma}\right)." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>ℙ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝒀</mi><mi>x</mi></msub><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>S</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>∩</mo><mrow><msub><mi>S</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">Φ</mi><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mi>σ</mi></mfrac><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{P}\big(\bm{Y}_{x}\in S_{\sigma}({x})\cap S_{\sigma}({x^{\prime}})\big)=\Phi_{d,c}\!\left(\frac{\|x-x^{\prime}\|}{\sigma}\right).</annotation></semantics></math></td>

</div>

<div id="A2.SS1.3" class="ltx_proof">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_font_italic ltx_title_proof">Proof.</h6>
<div id="A2.SS1.p10" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS1.p10.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p10.1.1" class="ltx_text">Let <math id="A2.SS1.p10.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Delta:=x-x^{\prime}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo>:=</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Delta:=x-x^{\prime}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A2.SS1.p10.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t:=\|\Delta\|/\sigma" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>:=</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo>/</mo><mi>σ</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t:=\|\Delta\|/\sigma</annotation></semantics></math>. Note that</span></p>
<table id="A2.Ex83" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex83.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{Y}_{x}\in S_{\sigma}({x})\iff\|\bm{Y}_{x}-x\|\in[\sigma r^{\mathrm{in}}_{c,d},\sigma r^{\mathrm{out}}_{c,d}]\iff\|\bm{Z}\|\in[r^{\mathrm{in}}_{c,d},r^{\mathrm{out}}_{c,d}]," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>𝒀</mi><mi>x</mi></msub><mo>∈</mo><mrow><msub><mi>S</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">⇔</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝒀</mi><mi>x</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>σ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mi>in</mi></msubsup></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>σ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mi>out</mi></msubsup></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">⇔</mo><mphantom></mphantom></mrow><mo fence="false">|</mo><mrow><mi>𝒁</mi><mo fence="false">|</mo><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msubsup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mi>in</mi></msubsup><mo>,</mo><msubsup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mi>out</mi></msubsup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{Y}_{x}\in S_{\sigma}({x})\iff\|\bm{Y}_{x}-x\|\in[\sigma r^{\mathrm{in}}_{c,d},\sigma r^{\mathrm{out}}_{c,d}]\iff\|\bm{Z}\|\in[r^{\mathrm{in}}_{c,d},r^{\mathrm{out}}_{c,d}],</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.p10.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p10.2.1" class="ltx_text">and</span></p>
<table id="A2.Ex84" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.Ex84.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{Y}_{x}\in S_{\sigma}({x^{\prime}})\iff\|\bm{Y}_{x}-x^{\prime}\|\in[\sigma r^{\mathrm{in}}_{c,d},\sigma r^{\mathrm{out}}_{c,d}]\iff\|\bm{Z}+\Delta/\sigma\|\in[r^{\mathrm{in}}_{c,d},r^{\mathrm{out}}_{c,d}]." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>𝒀</mi><mi>x</mi></msub><mo>∈</mo><mrow><msub><mi>S</mi><mi>σ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">⇔</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝒀</mi><mi>x</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>σ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mi>in</mi></msubsup></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>σ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mi>out</mi></msubsup></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">⇔</mo><mphantom></mphantom></mrow><mo fence="false">|</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>𝒁</mi><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo>/</mo><mi>σ</mi></mrow></mrow><mo fence="false">|</mo><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msubsup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mi>in</mi></msubsup><mo>,</mo><msubsup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mi>out</mi></msubsup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{Y}_{x}\in S_{\sigma}({x^{\prime}})\iff\|\bm{Y}_{x}-x^{\prime}\|\in[\sigma r^{\mathrm{in}}_{c,d},\sigma r^{\mathrm{out}}_{c,d}]\iff\|\bm{Z}+\Delta/\sigma\|\in[r^{\mathrm{in}}_{c,d},r^{\mathrm{out}}_{c,d}].</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.p10.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p10.3.1" class="ltx_text">Choose an orthogonal matrix <math id="A2.SS1.p10.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Q\in O(d)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>Q</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mi>O</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>d</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Q\in O(d)</annotation></semantics></math> such that <math id="A2.SS1.p10.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Q(\Delta/\sigma)=te_{1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>Q</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo>/</mo><mi>σ</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>e</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Q(\Delta/\sigma)=te_{1}</annotation></semantics></math>.
Since <math id="A2.SS1.p10.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{Z}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I_{d})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝒁</mi><mo>∼</mo><mrow><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒩</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>I</mi><mi>d</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{Z}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I_{d})</annotation></semantics></math> is rotation invariant, <math id="A2.SS1.p10.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="Q\bm{Z}\stackrel{{\scriptstyle d}}{{=}}\bm{Z}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>Q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝒁</mi></mrow><mover><mo>=</mo><mi>d</mi></mover><mi>𝒁</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Q\bm{Z}\stackrel{{\scriptstyle d}}{{=}}\bm{Z}</annotation></semantics></math>.
Therefore,</span></p>
<table id="A2.EGx6" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex86.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\mathbb{P}\Big(\|Q\bm{Z}\|\in[r^{\mathrm{in}}_{c,d},r^{\mathrm{out}}_{c,d}],\ \|Q\bm{Z}+Q(\Delta/\sigma)\|\in[r^{\mathrm{in}}_{c,d},r^{\mathrm{out}}_{c,d}]\Big)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>ℙ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em">(</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><mi>Q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝒁</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msubsup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mi>in</mi></msubsup><mo>,</mo><msubsup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mi>out</mi></msubsup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>Q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝒁</mi></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi>Q</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo>/</mo><mi>σ</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msubsup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mi>in</mi></msubsup><mo>,</mo><msubsup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mi>out</mi></msubsup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\mathbb{P}\Big(\|Q\bm{Z}\|\in[r^{\mathrm{in}}_{c,d},r^{\mathrm{out}}_{c,d}],\ \|Q\bm{Z}+Q(\Delta/\sigma)\|\in[r^{\mathrm{in}}_{c,d},r^{\mathrm{out}}_{c,d}]\Big)</annotation></semantics></math></td>

<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_eqn_cell"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex87.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\mathbb{P}\Big(\|\bm{Z}\|\in[r^{\mathrm{in}}_{c,d},r^{\mathrm{out}}_{c,d}],\ \|\bm{Z}+te_{1}\|\in[r^{\mathrm{in}}_{c,d},r^{\mathrm{out}}_{c,d}]\Big)=\Phi_{d,c}(t)." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>ℙ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em">(</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝒁</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msubsup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mi>in</mi></msubsup><mo>,</mo><msubsup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mi>out</mi></msubsup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><mi>𝒁</mi><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>e</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msubsup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mi>in</mi></msubsup><mo>,</mo><msubsup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow><mi>out</mi></msubsup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">Φ</mi><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\mathbb{P}\Big(\|\bm{Z}\|\in[r^{\mathrm{in}}_{c,d},r^{\mathrm{out}}_{c,d}],\ \|\bm{Z}+te_{1}\|\in[r^{\mathrm{in}}_{c,d},r^{\mathrm{out}}_{c,d}]\Big)=\Phi_{d,c}(t).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.p10.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p10.4.1" class="ltx_text">∎</span></p>
</div>
